scope: Confirmation protocol for a candidate defense after a complete remote transcript has been captured. Historical artifacts are exploratory and do not satisfy this protocol.

required_arms.naked_no_randomization: D=64 with the randomization layers off and shape-matched inert padding. Isolates the randomization stack.
required_arms.naked_full_width: Full-width D=1024 with the defense disabled. Isolates the bottleneck.
required_arms.defended: Frozen candidate defense under the exact same corpus/task, model, transcript, and attack budget.
required_arms.shuffled_label: Negative control that preserves views and globally permutes only evaluator labels.
required_arms.injected_leak: Exact-codeword leakage injection inside the defended representation, across predeclared dose, token-frequency, frame-length, and training-size sweeps.

statistical_plan.inferential_unit: training run or document/block, never independently sampled token rows
statistical_plan.uncertainty: paired cluster bootstrap or hierarchical model, with effect sizes and confidence intervals
statistical_plan.second_task: required unless an explicit limitation is recorded

freeze_rules: Set pass/fail thresholds before running the defended confirmation arm.
Tune only on development data and keep adaptive red-team implementations separate from defense tuning.
Do not report MINE or Donsker-Varadhan values as privacy certificates.
Do not report a complete-cloud claim until every required complete-view arm and control is recorded.
required_reporting: configuration, tokenizer, corpus split, and code commit

amendments.change: Replaced the single 'representation-matched naked control' with three distinct controls.
amendments.reason: Identical frame length and zero chaff are mutually exclusive - chaff is what expands a 32-row frame to 80 - so one matched naked control is not constructible. See PLAN.md W2.2.

amendments.change: Flipped status from pending_freeze to frozen; candidate_frozen=True. Declared pre-declared thresholds for the four emitting metrics (token_top1, rare_token_top1, token_cross_entropy, membership_auc) from the W2.4 calibration matrix and W2.6 map; declared remaining families unmeasured.
amendments.reason: W2.3, W2.4, W2.5, W2.6 are complete; the calibration matrix is stable; W8 external audit and prior-art positioning are banked. F.1 gate unblocked.

open_requirements: family_to_metric_applicability_map (PLAN.md W2.6): exact-codeword injection is not a representation-matched positive control for membership AUC, property AUC, semantic recovery, response-side leakage, timing, or active attacks.
seams S2/S4/S6 from docs/THREAT_MAP.md have no attack family here (PLAN.md W2.6).

sequence_exact_match.unavailable_reason: Released rows carry a fresh token permutation per frame; sequence order is not recoverable from any released artifact. Needs the trusted-side permutation, which is correctly sealed.

semantic_recovery.unavailable_reason: No similarity measure has been chosen. PLAN.md W2.6 records this as an open item that must be named before freeze.

property_auc.unavailable_reason: Needs per-row property labels, which no capture carries.

response_side_recovery.unavailable_reason: Needs response-side capture. The transcript protocol records the forward and backward wire, not the response.
